heading: Edit a CCC site
intro: Pick the site you want to change. **Edit** opens it in Pages CMS. **View** opens the live site so you can check your work.
steps: Use the sign-in link Pages CMS emailed you. You only see the sites you've been invited to.
Each site's sidebar follows the page from top to bottom, and every field says where it shows up.
Click **Save**. The live site updates in about a minute.
Keep photos under 1 MB. Every save is kept in history, so any change can be undone.
